_notes: Park Prizes (M3). Awarded in this order. `threshold` = cumulative General Store spend (state.store_spend: fences, facility upgrades, advertising, food, across every tab) that earns the prize; `milestone` prizes are earned by a park achievement instead ({ type: 'species', count } = that many distinct species alive at once; { type: 'rating_quarter', stars } = a quarter closes with the park rating at or above that many stars). Each prize is a decorative feature drawn in the living view at the world positions below (tiles, same frame as parcels.json) and adds `appeal_bonus` to the park appeal multiplier. The banner's `half_w` is half the span between its poles and `h` the pole height (tiles); it stands across the spine just inside the gate, x nudged east by the oblique shear so it sits centred over the gate on screen, deep and tall enough that its cloth clears the ENTRANCE lintel, the arch's pennants and the Grand Entrance towers' lettering window (DPS.selfTest checks it). `render` keys: banner, flower_beds, gate_arch, fountain (with `level` 1-3: the plaza fountain's three looks), statues, lamp_posts, carousel, grand_entrance. Prizes persist in the save. Phase 2b: thresholds re-tuned to match reduced facility costs and concession_k 2.0; good-run player earns all 8 by Y4 with ~1 per 2 quarters.

prizes.name: Welcome Banner
prizes.blurb: A cloth banner strung across the entrance path. The park has a name now.

prizes.name: Flower Beds
prizes.blurb: Planted beds along the main path and around the fountain.

prizes.name: Fancy Gate Arch
prizes.blurb: A carved arch over the front gate with finials and a painted sign.

prizes.name: Fountain: Stone Basin
prizes.blurb: The plaza fountain gets a wider stone basin and a raised second bowl.

prizes.name: Dinosaur Statues
prizes.blurb: Two stone dinosaurs guard the plaza on the gate side.

prizes.name: Lamp Posts
prizes.blurb: Lamp posts line the spine and the cross path. The park stays open after dusk.

prizes.name: Fountain: Twin Jets
prizes.blurb: Eight jets and lit water. The fountain is the centrepiece it was meant to be.

prizes.name: Carousel
prizes.blurb: A turning carousel on the plaza corner, with dinosaurs to ride.

prizes.name: Fountain: Grand Cascade
prizes.blurb: Ten species under one roof earns a cascade: a tall central jet, gold trim and the sculpture on a proper plinth.

prizes.name: Grand Entrance
prizes.blurb: Your first five-star quarter. Twin towers, flags and a gold fascia over the gate: the front of a great park.
